name: volume-resolver
title: Robust split-volume resolution
description: Replace filename-only first-volume skipping with a content-first, Unicode-aware split-volume resolver for RAR/ZIP/7z. Resolve disguised filenames, alternate copies, missing/ambiguous members, and materialize canonical backend-visible volume names through CoW clone/copy staging.
creator: charl
notes: Current main-loop is_first_volume() is filename-only and runs before structural detection. This task replaces that shortcut with a shared resolver used by list/extract and nested candidates. Generic arbitrary byte-split files and cross-file continuation of embedded archives are explicitly out of scope.

decisions.filename_role: sequence hypothesis and relative ordering only; never authoritative completeness
decisions.missing_volume: definite static missing-volume evidence is terminal for the current logical archive
decisions.completeness_uncertain: continue when membership/order are uniquely resolved
decisions.sequence_model: one ordinal token varies per hypothesis
decisions.unicode: use mature normalization/numeral libraries; do not maintain custom numeral tables
decisions.non_archive_magic: replace handwritten common-file magic with infer
decisions.alternate_candidates: allow bounded alias recovery and sampled fingerprinting; no full-file hash
decisions.membership_search: allow strong-evidence prefix/suffix interval clipping; forbid arbitrary subset search
decisions.materialization: canonical staging via CoW/reflink clone with regular copy fallback
